user.title: Usage Instructions
user.description:
### Please confirm the following information:
1. You have fully read and accepted the **Disclaimer** on the project homepage.
2. You have fully read and accepted the **Usage Instructions** on the project homepage.
3. You have fully read the **detailed configuration and usage guide**.

data.accept_terms: I have confirmed the above information and voluntarily accept its causal consequences.

account.title: CTC Account Configuration
account.description:
### Notes:
- Please enter your account identifier and access password.
- This integration supports up to 5 accounts.
- Adding multiple accounts may experience delays, please be patient.

sms.title: SMS Verification to Activate Device
sms.description: An SMS verification code has been sent to account {phonenum}. Enter the 6-digit code from the SMS to activate the current device, then the setup will be completed automatically via password login.

reconfigure.title: Update CTC Access Credentials
reconfigure.description:
Reconfigure access credentials (password/account). The current Device ID is stored in persistence and will be reused directly on re-login without modification; copy it for reference if needed:

`{device_id}`

If a security verification is triggered, the flow switches to SMS activation of the current device.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description:
Credentials for account {phonenum} have expired. Please update the access password. The current Device ID is stored in persistence and will be reused directly on re-login without modification; copy it for reference if needed:

`{device_id}`

If a security verification is triggered, the flow switches to SMS activation of the current device.

error.terms_not_accepted: Please confirm the usage instructions first
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the server or the account is temporarily restricted
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials, please check the password or device ID
error.need_captcha: Security verification triggered; the flow will switch to SMS activation automatically. Please follow the prompts to complete SMS verification.
error.sms_send_failed: Failed to send the SMS code (including slider fallback). Please retry later or change the network environment.
error.sms_invalid_code: The SMS verification code was rejected. Please confirm the 6-digit code from the SMS.
error.sms_verify_failed: Device still failed the security verification after activation. Please re-initiate SMS verification.
error.reconfigure_failed: Failed to update credentials, please check the password or device ID

abort.max_accounts_reached: Account limit reached (max 5 accounts). Please remove extra accounts and try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the server. Please try again later.
